title: Unification of Quantum Graph Properties
summary: Many properties of classical graphs are defined in terms of subsets of the vertex set. Examples include connected components, which are subsets $X \subseteq V(G)$ such that $X \times X^c$ and $E(G)$ are disjoint, or independent sets, for which $X \times X$ and $E(G)$ are disjoint. Direct generalisations of these definitions to quantum graphs are difficult to achieve, since the natural notion of subsets of a quantum set is much too rigid.
